criteria.evidence: All five frames are frozen with an exact variant, exclusions, applicability boundary, primary and corroborating sources, and six separate authority roles. P05: recommender none, decision_authority none. P10: frame 'recommender: strategy_sponsor_or_design_team', 'decision_authority: accountable_decision_maker'; frame is analytic (p10.u08). P11: compare_advise (recommend), assure (performer/judgment_owner appraisal_assurance_reviewer, recommender none) and decide_feedback are separate records, and prohibited edge p11.c19 is in place. I downloaded the official Green Book 2026 PDF: its SHA-256 275602ac...cc37 matches sources.md, and paragraphs 4.28, 5.13, 5.16 and 5.35 exist, so the paragraph anchors resolve. P12: judgment_owner is individual_anonymous_panelists only on round1-3 and delphi_method_lead elsewhere; interpret has 'consensus_is_a_panel_state_not_truth'; c19 is prohibited. I fetched the Turoff 'The Policy Delphi' Internet Archive capture: its SHA-256 d4cc8da0...afa43 matches sources.md, it has 17 pages starting at p. 80, and these cited passages are on the cited pages: 'no experts, only informed advocates and referees' (p. 80), 'not a mechanism for making a decision' (p. 80), 'would require five rounds' and 'will not get the same complete treatment' (p. 84), the four scales (p. 85), 'five to ten times' and 'In a three-round exercise a revote is taken on the third round' (p. 88). P13: each strand has its own performer, judgment owner and acceptance authority (qualitative_team/qualitative_strand_lead/qualitative_method_reviewer and the quantitative equivalents), and meta_infer requires both strand slots plus fit through p13.c18. Negative controls pass: no frame lets consensus equal truth, no frame merges a recommendation with the accountable decision, and no frame flattens the strand warrants.

Validator: 'RESULT: PASS (exit 0) methods=5 errors=0 warnings=0'. I also ran my own check. Every required input either has an incoming typed connection or is listed in frame external_entry_inputs. Every from_output/to_input exists with a matching type. Every declared required or optional cycle is closed along its listed edges and returns to its start node. No prohibited edge shares its from/to with a permitted connection. Every move has the instrument fields and all three guards. Negative-control loops are present. P05 theoretical sampling: required cycles c03/c05/c07/c09 and c05/c07/c27, with the prior category version carried back by c27-c29. P10 adaptive strategy: required c05/c08/c10/c12, plus futures via c17. P12 Delphi feedback is unrolled into three fed rounds (c05, c10; p12.u06). P11 appraisal return: c22/c23, and assurance rework c24/c25. P13 divergence disposition: c15-c17, each with termination and termination_authority. Uncertainty items distinguish known, unknown, contested and source_limited, and each states its downstream effect. The remaining issues are should_fix typing slips.
